d: Spiky, medium-length platinum white hair with long, face-framing bangs and a sharp, wind-swept texture. Narrow, sharp-angled purple eyes with a calm, focused expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a white and navy blue hooded cloak over brown leather pauldrons and polished silver plate armor. A circular silver emblem is pinned to the left side of the brown leather shoulder guard.
